title: Brainwave.io - Landing Page UI Kit - SaaS Landing Page - Creative App Landing Page
description: Brainwave.io is a comprehensive SaaS landing page UI kit built on a 12-column responsive grid system at 1920px. The kit delivers a complete set of landing page components designed for software-as-a-service products, mobile apps, and creative digital products. The layout emphasizes clear visual hierarchy with a hero section featuring bold headline typography, supporting subtext, and prominent call-to-action buttons. Feature sections are laid out in a clean card-based grid showcasing app capabilities with iconography and descriptive text. The pricing section uses a tiered comparison table, and the design includes testimonial carousels, integration showcases, app store badge placements, and footer navigation. The UI kit employs a modern, minimalist aesthetic with generous whitespace, soft shadows, and rounded corners. Color palette is built around a primary brand accent against neutral backgrounds, with ample contrast for readability. The component system includes navigation bars, hero sections, feature grids, pricing tables, testimonial blocks, FAQ accordions, call-to-action sections, and form elements. Organized with named layers and groups in Figma, the kit supports drag-and-drop customization and uses free Google Fonts throughout. The responsive design approach ensures compatibility across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports through a flexible grid architecture.
primary_use_case: Best suited for SaaS startups and mobile app companies needing a complete, professional landing page with all key conversion sections ready to customize.
style_vibe: Modern, clean, professional with soft shadows and rounded UI elements — a contemporary SaaS aesthetic optimized for trust and conversion.
